parameters.network_structure:
TD3Policy(
  (actor): Actor(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (mu): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=31, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=2, bias=True)
      (5): Tanh()
    )
  )
  (actor_target): Actor(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (mu): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=31, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=2, bias=True)
      (5): Tanh()
    )
  )
  (critic): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
  (critic_target): ContinuousCritic(
    (features_extractor): FlattenExtractor(
      (flatten): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)
    )
    (qf0): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
    (qf1): Sequential(
      (0): Linear(in_features=33, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (1): ReLU()
      (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
      (3): ReLU()
      (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=1, bias=True)
    )
  )
)
parameters.sb3_update_counter_semantics: SB3 gradient iterations; actor/critic/entropy optimizer calls are counted separately

replay_buffer_snapshot.sampling_count_basis: replay draws with replacement, not unique transitions or optimizer updates
replay_buffer_snapshot.flush_claim_boundary: Storage only. Final emitted tails are not asserted to have been sampled or learned.

approximation.return: sum of observed behavior rewards with undiscounted endpoint bootstrap
